stem: A test's guardrail, the unsubscribe rate, rose by 8% relative with p = 0.30. The tolerance is +5% relative. The team says: "Not significant, so no harm." What is right?

options.text: The team is right: a guardrail rise that is not significant shows there is no harm
Not significant is not proof of no harm; the rise must be shown to stay within +5%
The guardrail should now become the success metric of the test instead
Guardrail results can be set aside, since only the success metric decides
